name: Masterpiece
summary: Art-auction board game where players buy and sell paintings with hidden values to amass the greatest fortune.
rules_text: Each player starts with $1,500,000 and one random painting whose hidden value card is clipped face-down to it. Paintings are public, values are private. On your turn roll two dice and move around a circular track. The space landed on triggers an event: Bank Auction of the top deck painting, Private Auction of one of your paintings chosen by the player to your left, optional buy from the bank for a listed price, forced or optional sale to the bank, forced sale to another player for $400,000, or free inheritance of the top painting. Auctions start at $100,000 with $50,000 increments, open to all eligible players in any order. High bidder pays the bank or the owner and takes painting plus new top value card. Play continues until the painting and value decks are exhausted, then cash plus revealed painting values are summed.
rating_reason: Auction bidding with hidden forgery values, bluffing and numeric bids fit engine.
